name: Filter Tasks
description: Tool to get all tasks matching the filter. Use when you need to retrieve tasks based on specific filter criteria. This is a paginated endpoint using cursor-based pagination.

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: IETF language tag defining what language filter is written in, if differs from default English.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of objects to return in a page (1-200). Default is 50.

query.title: Query
query.description: Filter tasks using Todoist filter syntax. Terms must be valid keywords or reference existing entities in the user's account. Comma operator (,) is NOT supported. **CRITICAL: Multiple filter conditions MUST be joined with explicit logical operators (&, |, !). Space-separated filters are INVALID and will fail.** Supported filters: predefined keywords ('today', 'overdue', 'no due date', 'all', etc.), priority ('p1'-'p4'), projects ('#Name'), labels ('@Name'), relative dates ('7 days', '-7 days'), date filters ('due before: YYYY-MM-DD', 'due after: YYYY-MM-DD'), created/deadline ('created after: -14 days'), search ('search: keyword'). Operators: '&' (AND), '|' (OR), '!' (NOT).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the next_cursor value from previous response to get next page.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: List of label names assigned to task

content.title: Content
content.description: Task title; supports markdown and hyperlinks

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns this task

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Time estimate with amount and unit or null

parent_id.description: Parent task ID (null for top-level tasks)

added_by_uid.description: ID of user who added the task (null for tasks created before this field was tracked)

assigned_by_uid.description: ID of user who assigned task

responsible_uid.title: Responsible Uid
responsible_uid.description: Responsible user ID or null if unassigned

completed_by_uid.title: Completed By Uid
completed_by_uid.description: ID of user who completed the task

date.title: Date
date.description: Date in format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS for datetime

lang.description: Language code for parsing the string value

name: Get All Tasks
description: Fetches all INCOMPLETE tasks from Todoist and returns their details. Supports cursor-based pagination. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - This endpoint only returns active (incomplete) tasks - Cannot retrieve completed tasks - use a different endpoint for that - Filter queries using 'completed', '!completed', or 'completed after' will fail - Project/label references must use ACTUAL EXISTING names from the user's account - Arbitrary text in filters causes 400 errors - use 'search: keyword' for text search Common use cases: - Get all tasks: no filter - Get today's tasks: filter="today" - Get overdue tasks: filter="overdue" - Get tasks from specific project: filter="#ProjectName" (project must exist) - Get high priority tasks: filter="p1" - Search task content: filter="search: keyword" - Paginate results: use limit and cursor parameters

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: List of task IDs to retrieve (alphanumeric string IDs).

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language code for parsing date/times in queries.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of tasks to return per page. Default is 50.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the next_cursor value from previous response to get next page.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Filter tasks using Todoist filter syntax. This endpoint only returns INCOMPLETE tasks. Terms must be valid keywords or reference existing entities; arbitrary text causes 400 errors. Supported filters: predefined keywords ('today', 'overdue', 'no due date', etc.), priority ('p1'-'p4'), projects ('#Name'), labels ('@Name'), relative dates ('7 days', '-7 days'), date filters ('due before: YYYY-MM-DD'), created/deadline ('created after: -14 days'), search ('search: keyword'). Operators: '&' (AND), '|' (OR), '!' (NOT). DO NOT USE: 'completed', '!completed', 'completed after' - these cause 400 errors on this endpoint (use TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETION_DATE instead).

name: Get User
description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need user details like email, name, preferences, karma, or subscription status.

input_parameters.title: GetUserRequest
input_parameters.description: Request model for retrieving current user information.

is_dst.title: Is Dst
is_dst.description: Whether daylight saving time applies (can be bool or int 0/1).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The user's timezone as a string value.

gmt_string.title: Gmt String
gmt_string.description: String value of the time difference from GMT.

token.title: Token
token.description: The user's token that should be used to call the other API methods.

tz_info.title: Tz Info
tz_info.description: The user's timezone information, which includes the timezone as a string value, the hours and minutes difference from GMT, whether daylight saving time applies denoted by is_dst, and a string value of the time difference from GMT that is gmt_string.

days_off.title: Days Off
days_off.description: Array of integers representing user's days off (between 1 and 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday).

features.title: Features
features.description: Feature flags and settings for the user.

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: The ID of the user's avatar.

theme_id.title: Theme Id
theme_id.description: The currently selected Todoist theme (a number between 0 and 13).

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: The user's real name formatted as Firstname Lastname.

joined_at.title: Joined At
joined_at.description: Date when user joined Todoist (ISO 8601 format).

next_week.title: Next Week

avatar_big.title: Avatar Big
